item.title: Meet the four Democrats who handed Trump a crucial win on Iran strikes
item.description: Several Democrats broke ranks and joined Republicans to sink a House bid, forcing Trump to seek approval for Iran strikes, a narrow vote that keeps US military assault in play and exposes deep divisions in Congress over war powers.

item.title: Russia calls for immediate cessation of hostilities as Putin dials Iran
item.description: Vladimir Putin reaffirms his country's position on regional tensions during a phone call with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian.

item.title: Lebanon says Israeli missile attacks wounded UN peacekeepers from Ghana
item.description: UNIFIL site in town of Qouzah in Bint Jbeil district was struck by Israeli missiles, resulting in several injuries for Ghanaian peacekeepers, say Lebanese media annd President Joseph Aoun.

item.title: Iran warns European countries will become 'legitimate targets' if they join US-Israel war
item.description: Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister Majid Takht-Ravanchi says Tehran has cautioned European states over becoming involved in war.

item.title: Trump says US to 'quadruple' weapons production as Iran exhausts US-Israeli defence systems
item.description: Major US defence companies agree to quadruple production of advanced weapons, says President Donald Trump on seventh day of US-Israel war against Iran.

item.title: Iran reportedly destroys $300M US missile defence radar in Jordan
item.description: Iran destroyed AN/TPY-2 THAAD radar at Muwaffaq Salti Air Base in the early days of the war, Bloomberg reports, with analysts saying it "would mark one of Iran’s most successful attacks so far."

item.title: US approves 'emergency' sale of 12,000 bomb casings to Israel worth $151M
item.description: Washington approves a $151.8 million in weapons sale to Israel, invoking emergency authority to waive congressional review requirements as US-Israel war against Iran intensifies.

item.title: Oil prices surge as Middle East war rages, stocks fall on US jobs
item.description: Fears rise that prolonged high energy prices could fuel global inflation and limit central banks’ ability to cut interest rates.

item.title: Daily News Brief | March 7th
item.description: Iran's UN envoy says 1,332 Iranian civilians killed in war. And UAE billionaire asks Trump 'Who gave you authority to drag our region into war with Iran?'

item.title: Russian strike on Kharkiv apartment block kills multiple people
item.description: Poland says it was scrambling military planes in response to the attack.
